newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCare stock tumbles on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCare stock tumbles on earnings warning.

text.p: The stock of PacifiCare Health Systems Inc. lost nearly 21 percent of its value Tuesday after the managed health care services provider said its results would fall short of Wall Street's expectations for the latest quarter.
In early trading, PacificCare's A shares tumbled $16.878 to $64.50 and its B shares fell $17.75 to $67.75, both on the Nasdaq market.

The Cypress, Calif.-based company said late Monday that its second-quarter earnings will be below analysts' consensus estimates of $1.16 a share. In last year's second quarter, it earned $8.57 million, or 27 cents a share.
The health maintenance organisation blamed the disappointing results partly on the poor performance of FHP International Co., which it acquired in February.
